project_name: Happiness Trading — E-Book Reader Web App

book_details.title: Happiness Trading
book_details.author: Ongah Hermanto
book_details.format: Interactive E-Book Web App with Page Flip Reader (react-pageflip) & PDF Exporter (A5)

parts_structure.title: Bagian 1: Mengenal Diri Sendiri Sebagai Trader
parts_structure.description: Menemukan gaya trading, mengenal bias psikologis, dan membentuk mindset dasar seorang trader.
chapters: Bab 1: Siapa Anda di Depan Chart?
Bab 2: Mengenali Karakter & Toleransi Risiko
Bab 3: Jebakan Ego dalam Keputusan Trading
Bab 4: Ekspektasi vs Realitas Pasar

parts_structure.title: Bagian 2: Mengelola Emosi dalam Trading
parts_structure.description: Menghadapi FOMO, Greed, Fear, Loss Aversion, dan menjaga kedamaian mental saat fluktuasi harga.
chapters: Bab 5: Menguasai Fear & Greed
Bab 6: Mengatasi Fear of Missing Out (FOMO)
Bab 7: Seni Menerima Cut Loss Tanpa Penyesalan
Bab 8: Menjaga Ketenangan di Tengah Volatilitas

parts_structure.title: Bagian 3: Mindfulness & Kesadaran Penuh
parts_structure.description: Penerapan teknik kesadaran penuh (mindfulness), pernapasan, dan meditatif dalam aktivitas trading harian.
chapters: Bab 9: Konsep Mindful Trading dalam Praktik
Bab 10: Jeda Sebelum Eksekusi Order
Bab 11: Meditasi Singkat untuk Fokus & Kejelasan
Bab 12: Menghubungkan Pikiran, Tubuh, dan Pergerakan Candlestick

parts_structure.title: Bagian 4: Membangun Sistem & Disiplin
parts_structure.description: Membuat Trading Plan, Manajemen Risiko (Risk Management), Jurnal Trading, dan Rutin Harian.
chapters: Bab 13: Merancang Trading Plan yang Berkelanjutan
Bab 14: Manajemen Risiko: Kunci Bertahan Hidup
Bab 15: Jurnal Trading sebagai Cermin Diri
Bab 16: Disiplin Tanpa Kompromi

parts_structure.title: Bagian 5: Trading for Fun, Not for Living
parts_structure.description: Mengubah filosofi trading dari beban hidup menjadi permainan penuh kebahagiaan dan kebebasan finansial.
chapters: Bab 17: Filosofi Trading for Fun
Bab 18: Melepaskan Beban Finansial Utama dari Trading
Bab 19: Menemukan Kebahagiaan Sejati dalam Proses
Bab 20: Menjadi Trader yang Berkelanjutan & Bahagia

aesthetic_archetype.name: Editorial Warm Analog & Mindful Candlestick
aesthetic_archetype.theme_feel: Warm ivory book paper aesthetic combined with subtle editorial graphic arts and refined Japanese zen/candlestick motifs. Evokes peace, financial clarity, and thoughtful reading.

layout_and_components.desktop: Two-page spread (Book style, 2 side-by-side pages on screens >= 1024px) with realistic center shadow spine and page-turn animation.
layout_and_components.mobile: Single page view (Responsive flip book mode on screens < 1024px).

top_toolbar.description: Sticky top bar over book canvas with ivory backdrop blur, border-b border-[#E8E2D5]
items: Page Indicator Pill / Dropdown e.g., 'Halaman 12 dari 84' (data-testid='page-indicator')

toc_sidebar.description: Collapsible interactive Table of Contents drawer/sidebar with search filter, progress indicators, part collapsibles, and clickable jump links to any chapter or section.
items: Front Matter Links (Judul, Persembahan, Kata Pengantar, Pendahuluan)
Parts 1 to 5 Accordion List with Chapter status (Completed/Current)
Back Matter Links (Penutup, Profil Penulis, Back Cover)

rules: Each Chapter MUST start on a Right Page in two-page spread mode.
Page numbers displayed cleanly at the bottom center or outer margins.
Generous margins (p-8 to p-12 inside page container) to avoid text collision.
Realistic page shadows and smooth flip transitions using react-pageflip.
Reflective editorial symbolic illustrations at each Chapter Opener page.

interactive_quiz_system.description: Interactive multiple choice evaluation quizzes at the end of each of the 5 Parts.
features: Instant score calculation & explanation of answers
State saved locally via localStorage (data-testid='quiz-option-x', data-testid='quiz-submit-button')
Mindset reflection scorecard upon finishing each quiz

download_pdf_feature.description: Generates or downloads complete formatted A5 PDF version of 'Happiness Trading' with chapters, illustrations, and reader notes.
download_pdf_feature.implementation: Uses browser print/html2pdf/jspdf clean print view layout in standard A5 proportions.

chapter_illustrations.caption: Simbolisme kesadaran dan keseimbangan batin dalam trading
Refleksi volatilitas pasar dan pengendalian emosi
Ketenangan dan kejelasan sebelum mengambil keputusan
Struktur dan disiplin konsisten dalam trading journal
Kebebasan dan kebahagiaan sejati seorang trader

instructions_to_main_agent: Use react-pageflip for the page turn engine. Ensure HTML elements inside pages are formatted cleanly as A5 proportions.
Implement two-page spread for desktop views (>= 1024px) and single page flip view for mobile devices (< 1024px).
Ensure every major Part Chapter starting page begins on a RIGHT-hand page in 2-page spread mode by inserting blank/opener buffer pages if needed.
The 20 chapters across 5 parts plus front matter and back matter should all be jumpable via the TOC sidebar.
Quizzes per part must save user selections in localStorage and show immediate feedback score card.
PDF exporter must create an A5 styled printable/downloadable PDF document containing the book contents.
Use subtle red (#C84B4B) and green (#3B8258) accents for candlestick theme indicators without overpowering the warm ivory (#FDFBF7) analog book aesthetic.
All interactive elements must include exact data-testid attributes specified.
